personality_one_liner: A calm, grounded, nature-inspired sanctuary where wellness feels sustainable, safe, and deeply personal.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Cards should never be flush to the screen edge; always use at least lg margin. Soft padding inside cards and around typography to feel airy and non-clinical.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary or brandTertiary tints instead of glass to maintain the matte, organic, grounded feel of the hand-drawn/editorial aesthetic.
dont's: Do not use heavy blur or glassmorphism. It clashes with the natural, non-digital sanctuary vibe.

screens.name: Auth & Welcome
screens.purpose: A calming entry into the app introducing Pritha's ethos before asking for credentials.

states.loading: Centered soft spinner with 'Preparing your sanctuary...' text
states.error: Soft error toast with retry button.

screens.layout: Hero image at the top with a subtle bottom gradient fade into the surface color. Fraunces display title 'Welcome to Pritha'. Clear Google and Email login buttons with pill radii. Generous spacing below the image.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Communicate the three pillars: Personalized Nutrition, Sustainable Habits, and Holistic Wellness.
screens.layout: Full-bleed imagery for each of the 3 steps. Apply a vertical linear gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) starting at 50% to ensure the white text placed at the bottom 30% is completely readable. A 'Next' FAB or sticky bottom button.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A daily wellness dashboard that feels supportive, offering quick actions and daily insights without overwhelming data.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders matching the rounded card shapes.
states.error: Readable message 'Could not load your daily insights.' with a Retry CTA.

screens.layout: Header: Warm greeting ('Good morning, Maya'). Section 1: Mood Check-in row (Great, Good, Okay, Low, Exhausted) in a horizontal scroll or wrapped flex. Section 2: Large Insight/Quote card with the calm nature hero image background and text overlaid using a scrim. Section 3: Quick Actions (2-column grid of pill-shaped or soft-rounded cards for 'Request Diet Plan' and 'Book Consult'). Section 4: About Yogini card with her profile photo, short bio, and subtle terracotta accent.

screens.name: Diet Plan Request
screens.purpose: A seamless, stress-free form to request a custom plan, highlighting the student vs regular pricing tiers.

states.error: Validation errors below inputs in error color.

screens.layout: Single column form. Labels above inputs. Clear, large toggle or segmented control for 'Student (₹250)' vs 'Regular (₹500)'. Sticky primary CTA 'Submit Request' at the bottom over scrolling content inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Consultation
screens.purpose: Allow users to book a 1:1 video session with Yogini for ₹750.

states.empty: Illustration of a calendar with 'No slots available right now.'

screens.layout: Editorial header explaining the value of the 1:1 session. A clean date picker followed by a grid of available time slots (chips). A sticky bottom CTA 'Book Session • ₹750'.

screens.name: Wellness Journal
screens.purpose: A private, safe space to log daily moods and thoughts without judgment.

states.empty: Notebook illustration with 'Your journal is empty. Take a deep breath and write your first entry.'

screens.layout: List view of past entries. Each card shows the date, the selected mood (with a subtle color tint), and a snippet of the text. A prominent FAB (floating action button) in brandPrimary for 'New Entry'.

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.purpose: Yogini's control center for managing requests, consultations, users, and payments.
screens.layout: Utilitarian but clean. Top summary metrics (Active Plans, Upcoming Consults). List of pending diet plan requests with quick 'Approve/Deny' actions. Easy navigation between Diet Requests, Consultations, and Payments.

onboarding_1.alt: Fresh healthy food and sustainable nutrition

onboarding_2.alt: Woman practicing yoga and holistic wellness

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the defined palette: sage green, soft cream, muted terracotta. Avoid all blues and purples.
Use Fraunces (weight 400/500) for large display headings to give a premium editorial feel, and DM Sans for clean, readable body text.
Implement a bottom tab navigator with 4 tabs: Home, Journal, Consult, Profile. The Admin features should live in a completely separate stack navigator accessible only to Yogini's account.

Whenever placing text over an image (like the Home Hero or Onboarding screens), you MUST implement the gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse vertical fade starting at 50% opacity). Text on images goes in the bottom 30-40%.

Cards should use surfaceSecondary (#F0EDE6) with zero drop shadow (shadow_tier: 0) to maintain the flat, grounded, hand-drawn/editorial aesthetic. Rely on generous xl spacing and border radius instead of elevation.
Ensure prices use the Indian Rupee symbol (₹). Student Pricing = ₹250, Regular = ₹500, Consultation = ₹750.
Include an AI Wellness Companion accessible via a FAB on the Home or Journal screens.
Implement the mood tracker as a tactile row of choices (Great, Good, Okay, Low, Exhausted) on both the Home screen check-in and the Journal New Entry flow.
